title: Bug arena game made with Claude Code: start as a grub, molt through 24 forms, fight with needles, matches and forks
author: vinishkapoor
selftext:
Grubsteel is a top-down arena brawler set in a garden at night. You start as a grub with a dress pin, drink nectar and beat rival bugs to grow, and molt through 24 forms up to the Emperor Beetle. To win, take the Garden King's bottle-cap crown and hold it for 60 seconds.

**Who made what:**

* **Code, bugs and weapon art:** made with Claude
* **Scenery:** from my free 3D model library
* **Music:** Komiku (CC0)
* **Sounds:** Freesound (CC0)

**What made it work:** giving each of the 47 weapons one clear behavior. Matches set bugs on fire, needles pierce a row, magnets pull rivals in, and claw hammers shake the ground. Each one was added and tested on its own. Hits from behind do double damage, and giants turn slowly, so small fast bugs still have a chance.
